---
title: "RNA-seq preprocessing ExR2"
output: html_notebook
---

Install the required packages
```{r}
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
#BiocManager::install(version = "3.14")
BiocManager::install("edgeR", force = TRUE)
require(edgeR)
```

Load the data
```{r}
dat_wb <- read.csv("data/rna_seq/lowCellSeq.csv",as.is=T,header=T)
celltyp_wb <- (do.call(rbind,strsplit(colnames(dat_wb),"_"))[,1])
dat_wb <- dat_wb[which((celltyp_wb == "wholebrain") | (celltyp_wb == "gene"))]

dat_ExR2 <- read.table("data/rna_seq/ExR2/merged_counts.txt",sep="\t",header=T)
subset
dat <- merge(dat_ExR2, dat_wb, by = "gene_id")
rownames(dat) <- dat$gene_id
dat <- dat[c(-1,-2)]

dat <- subset(dat, select = -c(Q5_F01_Sample_MB233B, Q5_F02_Sample_MB136B, 
                               Q5_A03_Sample_MB233B, Q5_B03_Sample_MB233B,
                               Q5_H02_Sample_MB136B, Q5_C03_Sample_MB136B, Q5_D03_Sample_MB136B))

celltyp <- c(do.call(rbind,strsplit(head(colnames(dat),13),"_"))[,4],
             do.call(rbind,strsplit(tail(colnames(dat),8),"_"))[,1])

dge_table=list()
```

Run the differential expression vs the whole brain
```{r}
celltype1_columns=which(celltyp=="MB233B")
celltype2_columns=which(celltyp=="wholebrain")

classvec=as.factor(rep(c(1,2),times=c(length(celltype1_columns),length(celltype2_columns))))
startmat_cpm=sweep(dat[,c(celltype1_columns,celltype2_columns)],2,colSums(dat[,c(celltype1_columns,celltype2_columns)]),"/")*10^6
e_design=model.matrix(~classvec)
y2 = DGEList(counts=dat[,c(celltype1_columns,celltype2_columns)])
y2 = estimateDisp(y2, e_design)
fit = glmQLFit(y2, e_design)
qlf.2vs1 <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef=2)
outval2=topTags(qlf.2vs1,n=nrow(startmat_cpm),p.value=1)
outval2$table=outval2$table[intersect(rownames(outval2$table),rownames(startmat_cpm)),]
mean1=apply(startmat_cpm[rownames(outval2$table),classvec==1],1,mean)
mean2=apply(startmat_cpm[rownames(outval2$table),classvec==2],1,mean)
frac1=rowSums(startmat_cpm[rownames(outval2$table),classvec==1]>0)/length(celltype1_columns)
frac2=rowSums(startmat_cpm[rownames(outval2$table),classvec==2]>0)/length(celltype2_columns)
dge_table[["MB233B_wholebrain"]]=cbind(outval2$table,mean1,mean2,frac1,frac2)
```

```{r}
celltype1_columns=which(celltyp=="MB136B")
celltype2_columns=which(celltyp=="wholebrain")

classvec=as.factor(rep(c(1,2),times=c(length(celltype1_columns),length(celltype2_columns))))
startmat_cpm=sweep(dat[,c(celltype1_columns,celltype2_columns)],2,colSums(dat[,c(celltype1_columns,celltype2_columns)]),"/")*10^6
e_design=model.matrix(~classvec)
y2 = DGEList(counts=dat[,c(celltype1_columns,celltype2_columns)])
y2 = estimateDisp(y2, e_design)
fit = glmQLFit(y2, e_design)
qlf.2vs1 <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef=2)
outval2=topTags(qlf.2vs1,n=nrow(startmat_cpm),p.value=1)
outval2$table=outval2$table[intersect(rownames(outval2$table),rownames(startmat_cpm)),]
mean1=apply(startmat_cpm[rownames(outval2$table),classvec==1],1,mean)
mean2=apply(startmat_cpm[rownames(outval2$table),classvec==2],1,mean)
frac1=rowSums(startmat_cpm[rownames(outval2$table),classvec==1]>0)/length(celltype1_columns)
frac2=rowSums(startmat_cpm[rownames(outval2$table),classvec==2]>0)/length(celltype2_columns)
dge_table[["MB136B_wholebrain"]]=cbind(outval2$table,mean1,mean2,frac1,frac2)
```

Save the data
```{r}
for (tablename in names(dge_table)) {
    write.csv(dge_table[[tablename]],file=paste0("data/rna_seq/dge/dge_table_",tablename,".csv"))
}
```
